name: Fugu Max
title: Fugu Max: price, context window and specs
answer: Fugu Max is a model in Sakana's Sakana Fugu family, first listed on 2026-09-11. It takes text, image and file in and returns text, with a context window of 1 million tokens and up to 128K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: Of the 3 versions of Sakana Fugu listed today, 1 are newer.
Its input price is below the family median of $5 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
